source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Physically install an NVMe switch adapter, power on, enter BIOS and verify controller/NVMe SSD information.
procedure_facts: Requires powered-down physical insertion followed by BIOS observation.
criteria_facts: BIOS entry succeeds and controller information displays correctly.
missing_source_information: Exact switch adapter/slot/firmware and downstream NVMe drive/port/serial map.
Power-down/ESD/cabling/SOP, expected BIOS fields and PCIe link/topology values.
Recovery if adapter or a downstream drive is absent.

original_test_intent.statement: After safe physical installation of the approved NVMe switch adapter, verify in BIOS that the adapter/controller and every expected downstream NVMe SSD are detected with correct information.
must_preserve: Physical adapter installation, cold power-on and BIOS verification.
must_not_infer: Generic HDD/SATA devices as targets despite the historical test-set label.
OS smartctl/lsblk as proof of BIOS visibility.
A switch port/device map or link capability from transient OS names.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly changes DeepSeek YES to MANUAL ONLY because physical installation and BIOS observation are essential; OS inventory only corroborates.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not require a powered-off/ESD installation gate, switch upstream/downstream port map, per-drive serial/namespace identity, PCIe link evidence or no-save BIOS exit/recovery.

related_records: OS NVMe inventory cannot replace this BIOS/switch detection test.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The `- NVMe` suffix and procedure resolve the historical HDD label toward NVMe; do not invent HDD coverage.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: A qualified operator must install and inspect BIOS after receiving the adapter/slot/drive map and physical SOP. Agent-collected OS/PCI data is post-boot corroboration only.

conditions_present: Physical and BIOS boundaries and target technology are clear.
missing: Adapter/slot/drive/port map, physical SOP, expected BIOS/controller/link fields, reboot window and recovery.
provider: Lab owner supplies operator, ESD controls and power window.
safe_read_only_work: Before shutdown, inventory current PCIe/NVMe topology and logs; inspect adapter documentation without changing hardware.
prohibited_until_resolved: Power transition, chassis open/insertion/cabling, BIOS entry/save, firmware change or PASS.
closure_evidence: Normal boot plus OS/PCI corroboration and final health.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify an NVMe Switch Adapter and Downstream SSDs in BIOS
revision_candidate.purpose: After a qualified operator safely installs the approved NVMe switch adapter, verify BIOS displays the correct adapter/controller identity and every expected downstream NVMe SSD/port, then corroborate the same topology after normal boot.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact server/chassis/BIOS, PCIe slot/riser/cabling/power, NVMe switch adapter model/firmware and downstream NVMe SSD models/serials/namespaces. This is not a SATA/SAS HDD test.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One signed adapter in one physical slot and every downstream port/device on the approved map. No firmware update, formatting or storage I/O workload.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Adapter/firmware/slot/riser/BDF and upstream-link expectation; downstream port-to-SSD serial/model/firmware/namespace map; power-off/ESD/insertion/cabling SOP; expected BIOS page/fields and link status; maintenance/KVM/operator approval; rollback/removal procedure.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture pre-change topology/logs, shut down and remove power per SOP, verify ESD and install/cable the exact adapter, close chassis and cold power on. Operator enters BIOS, captures adapter/controller and every downstream device/port field, exits without saving and boots normally. Agent may then collect complete PCIe/NVMe topology, link width/speed, serial/model/firmware and logs for correlation, not substitution.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Maintenance approved; backup/OS storage protected; operator/ESD tools/SOP present; exact parts/slot/cabling verified; console and rollback available.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Pre-change state; operator/SOP/part/slot/cable identity; power-off/ESD/install checklist; BIOS/server identity; unedited BIOS screens for controller and every downstream port/SSD; expected-versus-actual map; no-save exit and normal boot; full post-boot PCIe topology/link and NVMe serial/model/firmware/namespace evidence; AER/kernel/SEL logs and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed platform/NVMe switch topology specification. Pass requires BIOS access, correct adapter/controller and complete downstream device map with no missing/unexpected devices or disallowed link downgrade/error, normal boot and clean health. OS-only detection cannot pass.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not hot-insert unless explicitly supported/approved, work with power present, skip ESD, choose slot/cable by guess, save BIOS settings, update firmware, format/write drives, use truncated first-device inventory, clear logs or claim physical/visual action by an Agent.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform/storage/lab owners approve physical change and window; qualified operator performs installation/BIOS observation; engineer judges topology/link exceptions.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical work and BIOS observation are manual. Agent may inventory before/after and correlate evidence.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On no-POST, missing device, AER/link fault or boot impact, stop, preserve screen/log state, power down per SOP, reseat or remove/restore original hardware only under owner direction, then verify baseline boot/storage health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: SOP/map/operator/window/recovery missing; part/slot/cable mismatch; power/ESD uncertainty; no POST/BIOS; controller or any downstream SSD absent/wrong; link downgrade/AER; BIOS change; boot/storage regression; incomplete visual evidence.

identified_defects: Historical HDD label can misdirect target selection.
No adapter/downstream port map or physical SOP.
DeepSeek substitutes OS inventory for BIOS/physical validation.
reason_for_change: Keep the actual NVMe switch hardware/BIOS intent and make physical safety, complete downstream mapping and OS non-substitution explicit.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Storage-00087-V003
new_technical_evidence.supports: NVMe switch insertion, power-on, BIOS device/controller check and 15/8-minute values.

removed_ambiguities: Defines target as NVMe switch rather than HDD.
Requires every downstream port/serial and link evidence.
Separates BIOS proof from OS corroboration.
resolved_blockers: Qualified operator can perform the test; physical boundary is MANUAL ONLY, not BLOCKED.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 adds a cold-power/ESD installation gate and requires BIOS evidence for the switch's complete downstream port-to-serial map, so a single OS-visible NVMe device cannot falsely complete the case.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Physical and BIOS manual boundary is explicit; no DUT validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 104 installs an NVMe switch adapter and verifies controller/SSD information in BIOS.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 rejects OS substitution; V3 adds physical SOP, full port/serial/link mapping and recovery.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Pre-change inventory only until operator/map/SOP/window approved.
